previous_source_baseline.reason: The 2026-08-13 refresh tracked kis-mcp repository history, not an immutable mcp-development comparison snapshot. Issue 57 establishes the first diffable MCP-guidance baseline without inventing a historical hash.

review_scope: MCP Skills transport compatibility and trust boundary
KIS HR-001/HR-002/HR-003 and Work Management preservation

decisions.topic: Protocol/version/transport/capability decisions are distinct from KIS operation
decisions.rationale: Adds an explicit handoff to mcp-development without turning kis-mcp into a second protocol guide.

decisions.topic: Capability support must be established from negotiated live runtime evidence
decisions.rationale: KIS diagnostics benefit directly from separating specification availability from negotiated client/server support.

decisions.topic: Large operation catalogues should use progressive discovery while preserving original schemas and authorization
decisions.rationale: KIS already implements a bounded direct profile plus search/describe/effect-dispatch long tail; the refresh records and preserves the stronger existing contract.

decisions.topic: Reconnect or refresh the target connection after tool metadata changes before diagnosing stale selection/schema behavior
decisions.rationale: Useful for KIS ChatGPT diagnostics; kept as target troubleshooting rather than core protocol policy.

decisions.topic: Emerging MCP Skills support remains a complementary read-only projection with KIS as catalogue/telemetry/governance authority
decisions.rationale: This is current repository-owned architecture and materially changes how future MCP-delivered skills must be interpreted.

decisions.topic: Per-file digests are integrity evidence; remote skill content remains untrusted and metadata grants no permissions
decisions.rationale: Directly protects KIS Skills security and preserves execution authority.

decisions.topic: MCP Apps UI resource/bridge/window.openai implementation guidance
decisions.rationale: kis-mcp is an operational workflow skill, not an MCP Apps UI implementation skill.

decisions.topic: MCPB manifest, bundled runtime, installation, and local packaging workflow
decisions.rationale: Local MCPB distribution is outside kis-mcp operation and remains owned by the packaging specialist.

decisions.topic: General MCP server construction, primitive design, transport implementation, and authorization architecture
decisions.rationale: Those concerns remain in mcp-development/openai-mcp-server unless a future KIS task specifically changes server implementation; copying them would broaden trigger scope and duplicate authority.

decisions.topic: Project-neutral routing, exact HR-001/HR-002/HR-003 semantics, Work Management projection model, effect dispatch, exact-head delivery, and runtime Skills telemetry
decisions.rationale: These KIS-specific semantics are stronger local governance and must not be replaced by generic MCP guidance.

kis_specific_overrides: Only HR-001, HR-002, and HR-003 are Work hard rules.
Repository/source/Git evidence is authoritative; Work Management is an operational projection.
Project identity and provider routing remain explicit and project-neutral.
Discovered operations retain original schema, effect, readiness, approval, and authorization boundaries.
Exact-head verification and governed delivery/closeout remain KIS/repository workflow concerns.
KIS Skills catalogue identity, immutable snapshot hashes, activation/outcome telemetry, and local governance remain authoritative over transport projections.
